# Get sent transactions for this month (May 2023)
sent_transactions = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=venmo_login['access_token'],
        direction='sent',
        min_created_at='2023-05-01',
        max_created_at='2023-05-31',
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20
    )
    if isinstance(page, dict) and 'message' in page:
        print("Error:", page)
        break
    sent_transactions.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

# Extract receiver emails
sent_receiver_emails = set()
for txn in sent_transactions:
    sent_receiver_emails.add(txn['receiver']['email'])
